definitions.explanation: The solid surface of the earth as opposed to the sea or air.

examples.japanese: {陸|りく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。

examples.english: I traveled by both land and sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{陸|りく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful because the typhoon is approaching land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んで→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦カエル→カエル：28199_kaeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陸|りく}⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Fish live in water, but frogs can also live on land.

notes:
{陸|りく} means dry land as opposed to water or air, often used in contrast with ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea) or ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (sky).

READING:
The standard reading is りく. The alternative reading おか appears in certain expressions, such as {陸|おか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to go ashore, or figuratively to be out of one's element).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{陸地|りくち}→陸地：14691_rikuchi⟧: dry land
- ⟦{陸上|りくじょう}→陸上：09245_rikujou⟧: on land; track and field (⟦{陸上|りくじょう}→陸上：09245_rikujou⟧⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧)
- ⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧: continent
- ⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧: landing, going ashore
- ⟦{陸軍|りくぐん}→陸軍：19089_rikugun⟧: army
- ⟦{陸路|りくろ}→陸路：28222_rikuro⟧: overland route

THREE DOMAINS:
Japanese often groups {陸|りく} (land), ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧/⟦{海|かい}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea), and ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧/⟦{空|くう}→空：02216_sora⟧ (air) as a set, especially in military and transport contexts.
